decisions: A reachable RuntimeReadInt function can emit process-exit on input failure, so the CSharp dependency planner must request its declaration. Fixed CSharp behavior is eight frozen input/exit/stdout oracles.
Use the WindowsLinkPolicy entry constant for both link arguments and the emitted Windows native entry name. Linux retains main/argc/argv; wasm retains its existing entry.

Read legacy Int input through the same exact shared bounded read/parser LLVM templates, including strict ASCII whitespace/digits, 64-byte reading, Int32 narrowing, failure exit and output flushing. Remove the getchar CRT dependency; do not extend import oracles to hide it.

NativeRuntimePolicy projects those compiled constants into a protected generated region in the existing llvm.runtime module. Existing authored content and source manifests are preserved; malformed regions, wrong namespaces, outside-region changes during a write, unsupported controls and nonconstant expressions fail.
GetLastError is one Windows runtime declaration shared by all required consumers, rather than independently emitted by overlapping feature branches.
